Lee Mantle lived longer than Silas Hardy. DBpedia data: Lee Mantle (dbr:Lee_Mantle) — birth 1851-12-13, death 1934-11-18 (lifespanDays = 30270); Silas Hardy (dbr:Silas_Hardy) — birth 1867-04-30, death 1905-06-27 (lifespanDays = 13927).

SPARQL query over dbpedia:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dbp: <http://dbpedia.org/property/>
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
SELECT ?person ?personLabel ?birth ?death ?lifespanDays WHERE {
  VALUES ?person {
    dbr:Silas_Hardy dbr:Lee_Mantle
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?person dbo:birthDate ?birth1 .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?person dbp:birthDate ?birth2 .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?person dbo:deathDate ?death1 .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?person dbp:deathDate ?death2 .
  }
  BIND(COALESCE(?birth1 , ?birth2) AS ?birth)
  BIND(COALESCE(?death1 , ?death2) AS ?death)
  FILTER(BOUND(?birth) && BOUND(?death))
  BIND(((YEAR(?death) - YEAR(?birth)) * 365 +(MONTH(?death) - MONTH(?birth)) * 30 +(DAY(?death) - DAY(?birth))) AS ?lifespanDays)
  OPTIONAL {
    ?person rdfs:label ?personLabel .
    FILTER(lang(?personLabel) = 'en')
  }
}
ORDER BY DESC(?lifespanDays)
LIMIT 2
